$comment: The town's calendar: how simulation time maps onto real time (REQ-OFF-001). Until now town time moved only when the player pressed 'Let a season pass', so the guild never worked while the player was away. realSecondsPerStep sets the live rate (a 20-step season is 10 minutes); maxOfflineHours is REQ-OFF-001's three-day cap; catchUpChunkSteps is how many steps catch-up advances between standing-order checks. absenceSteps is how long a gap in the live clock must be before it counts as the player being away rather than a throttled background tab: browsers slow hidden-tab timers to once a minute at most, so ten steps (five minutes) only trips when the tab was frozen or the machine slept, and that gap is then caught up with a Guild Report exactly as a reload would be. PENDING APPROVAL (DL-058, DL-066).
